headline: Modaxo Acquires Brazil-Based Fiscaltech to Expand Traffic Management
summary: Modaxo Group has acquired Fiscaltech, strengthening its traffic management offerings and extending its market reach in Brazil and South America.
why: Corporate acquisitions in transportation technology allow global infrastructure firms to expand geographic footprints and service offerings in emerging markets.
